title: Final ZIP Validation Companion-Proof Design
problem: Including validation proof inside ZIP changes the ZIP hash, creating circular dependency

design.description: Validation proof is written as a separate file next to the ZIP, not inside it
guarantees: Companion proof names exact ZIP path
Companion proof contains ZIP SHA256 computed after ZIP is finalized
ZIP hash is stable — no post-creation modifications
Companion proof is generated by generate_companion_proof() which calls generate_validation_proof()
